understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by activating all goal cells on the grid. A goal cell only counts as completed when the piece I am carrying matches that goal cell’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time, and I then step onto the goal cell. Completing all goals advances to the next level; completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn I choose a movement action (north/east/south/west). Movement can be blocked by walls, in which case my position does not change but stamina is still consumed. As I move around the grid, stepping on modifier tiles changes my carried piece’s attributes: shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle the piece’s color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. I need to route through these modifiers to make my current piece match the active goal requirements, then step onto the goal cell to activate it. Every action costs stamina; when stamina reaches 0, the next action causes me to lose a life and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
